shared_tile_registers.sharing_domain: one bank private to each core and shared by its four PEs
shared_tile_registers.quarter_selection: B.IOS 3-bit PEMode decoded to the fixed four-PE mask; zero means NOP
shared_tile_registers.access: all four PEs may access all shared registers and independently select tile offsets
shared_tile_registers.initial_state: uninitialized; reads behave like undefined-register reads
shared_tile_registers.ordering: no architectural order beyond atomicity; software prevents conflicting code/offset accesses
